# Vulkan headers 1.4.357

Unmodified Khronos Vulkan-Headers umbrella/core/platform and required video headers.
SPDX: Apache-2.0 OR MIT; distributed here under the MIT option (LICENSE-MIT.txt).
Source project: https://github.com/KhronosGroup/Vulkan-Headers

Copied locally from the existing Arch package cache on 8 September 2026:
`vulkan-headers-1:1.4.357.0-1-any.pkg.tar.zst`.
No SDK or system package installation is needed to build this module.
Only types and function declarations are compiled; Vulkan is dynamically loaded.
`manifest.json` records SHA-256 hashes of the unmodified header files.
